answer.rationale: Rollback is ruled out: compliance forbids reverting the security patch, so memory_b1 does not apply. Circuit breaking risks dropping settlement writes, which violates the no-lost-writes objective. Regional failover is unsupported by any regional symptom and is high-risk mid-peak. Remaining options are add_capacity vs route_read_replicas. memory_b5 directly links offloading report/read load to recovered transactional write latency without discarding writes; memory_b3 is about headroom provisioned before a peak, so adding capacity now is less clearly timely. Intend a small guarded test of read-replica routing for report queries to relieve the primary write path while settlement is hot. Cause is still ambiguous (patch cost vs mixed-load saturation vs something else); verifying b5 and b3 before a larger move. Downstream settlement value is flagged: do not shed customer writes.
